25:2: and have them separate before Me a terumah-offering.
From every man whose heart impels him to generosity
25:4: Greenish-blue [wool], dark red [wool], crimson colored [wool], fine linen, and goats [hair].
25:5: Red[-dyed] ram’s skins, multicolored skins, and acacia wood.
25:7: Onyx stones, and filling stones for setting [into]
25:8: They shall make a Sanctuary before Me,
and I will [then] rest My Shechina among them.
25:19: Make one cherub out of one side,
and one cherub out of the other side.
From the [same piece of gold as] the cover itself, you shall make the cherubim on its two sides.
25:22: I will prepare My Word with you there,
and I will speak with you from above the cover, from between the cherubim
that are on the Ark of the Testimony.
All that which I will command you concerning the B’nei Yisrael.
25:25: Make a ledge of a tefach high around [the table],
and make a gold crown-like rim around the ledge.
26:1: You shall [then] make the mishkon (Tabernacle) out of ten drapes,
[consisting of] fine twined linen, greenish blue, dark red and crimson colored [wool].
Figures of cherubim, the work of a craftsman, shall be woven into them.
26:14: Make a covering for the tent
out of red dyed ram’s skins,
and a covering of multicolored skins above that.
26:23: for the corners of the mishkon
26:31: You shall make a paroches [partition] out of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, and twined, fine linen.
It shall be the work of a craftsman, with figures of cherubim [woven into it].
26:36: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent.
[Make it out of] greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, and twined, fine linen.
It shall be the work of an embroiderer.
27:3: Make its pots to collect its ashes,
its flesh hooks, and its fire pans.
Make all of its vessels out of copper.
27:16: The entrance of the enclosure shall have a screen of twenty amohs. [It shall be made of] greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, and twined, fine linen. It shall be the work of an embroiderer.
